spec: dynamics.leap_frog_velocity, dynamics.leap_frog_position, dynamics.kinetic_energy, dynamics.group_kinetic_energy, dynamics.kinetic_temperature, dynamics.pressure_tensor, dynamics.scalar_pressure, dynamics.berendsen_barostat_scale
generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.Dynamics.*Float; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits (f64::to_bits, Float.toBits); n is a plain integer
layout_leap_frog: v(3), f(3), inverse_mass, dt, x(3), v_new(3), x_new(3); x_new is leap_frog_position(x, v_new, dt)
layout_kinetic: n, then (mass, v_new(3), v_old(3)) per atom, then kinetic_energy (average, new) and group_kinetic_energy (com, total, new_com, new_total)
layout_pressure: kinetic(9), virial(9), volume, pressure(9), scalar_pressure; tensors by columns (x_axis, y_axis, z_axis), each x, y, z
layout_barostat: pressure, pressure0, compressibility, tau, dt, mu
